description: The chloride end member of CSHQ fitted by ChemistryLab on the sorption tests of Hirao et al. (2005). Only the fitted parameter and its provenance are stored; the thermodynamic record is built from the downloaded Cemdata18 database (src/databases/derived.jl).
name: (CaCl2)0.5, chloride end member of CSHQ fitted by ChemistryLab

provenance.activity_model: Debye-Hueckel limiting law with B-dot, a = 0, B-dot identified from test/reference/gems_cemdata18_portland.json
provenance.data: Fig. 5, bound chloride per gram of hydrated alite, the points up to 1 mol/L (data/literature/Hirao2005.json)
provenance.estimated: S and V: those of the ions it is made of (no entropy or volume of dissolution); heat capacity zero; H from G and S
provenance.parameter: delta_J_per_mol: the Gibbs energy of forming CSHQ-Cl from 1//2 Ca+2 + 1 Cl- at 293.15 K and 1 bar

rejected_candidate.reason: binds less chloride at the higher Ca/Si, against the measured trend; the silica it carries is favored by the silica activity of a low-Ca/Si gel
